item.title: Missed That $149 AirPods Pro 3 Deal? Amazon Just Brought It Back
item.dc:creator: Mitchel Broussard
item.description:
Apple's AirPods Pro 3 have returned to their all-time low price of $149.00 on Amazon, down from $249.00. This price appeared yesterday morning, then disappeared overnight, but it's back now and still one of the best deals this Black Friday season.

item.title: Tidal Bans AI Music, While Apple Music Sticks to Labels
item.dc:creator: Juli Clover
item.description:
Streaming music service Tidal today said it plans to start blocking AI music on December 9. Any track generated entirely with AI will be removed from the platform, with Tidal rejecting AI songs in the future.
